stem: Marlow Credit's release pipeline runs no Terraform commands. It packages each build of the configuration and sends web requests to HCP Terraform that start a run, and the workspace has no linked repository. Which description fits this setup?

choices.text: The API-driven workflow, where the company's own tooling uploads a `.tar.gz` and starts the run
The UI/VCS-driven workflow, where the platform fetches the configuration from version control
The CLI-driven workflow, where engineers start runs with the standard plan and apply commands
A run trigger, where a successful apply in a source workspace queues the run

rationale: In the API-driven workflow the workspace is not associated with a repository, and the company's own tooling decides when to run and uploads the configuration as a `.tar.gz` file, which matches a pipeline that packages each build and calls HCP Terraform. The UI/VCS-driven workflow links the workspace to a branch and HCP Terraform pulls the code, but this workspace has no linked repository and HCP Terraform does not fetch configuration from version control here. The CLI-driven workflow is started with the standard plan and apply commands, and the pipeline runs none. A run trigger queues a run after a successful apply in another workspace, not after a pipeline sends a build.
